about: A fictional entity, a canary image and a canary vector the leak gate must catch before any real check is trusted. The entity's hashes are present in names.sha1, ngrams6.sha1 and numphrases.sha1; the image's sha256 and dHash in media.json; the vector's signature digest in vectors.sha1. The gate plants probe_text and asserts a hit in each text file, decodes the image and parses the vector and asserts each is found, then asserts clean_text gives none.
probe_text: Quorvane Biologics moved its oncology launch planning onto one shared platform last spring, with 7,431 vials tracked weekly.
clean_text: Lantern teal otters juggle seven quiet marmalade kites beside wandering copper violins.
